title: Sacred Valley → Aguas Calientes

weather.note: Milder valley day; dropping into cloud forest, humidity rises — keep a rain layer handy.

glance: Scenic run through the Sacred Valley with a community visit & lunch, then the train from Ollantaytambo to Aguas Calientes at the foot of Machu Picchu.

travel.detail: Cusco → Sacred Valley → Ollantaytambo → Aguas Calientes
notes: Sit on the left side of the train
Community lunch included on the way

picks.name: Maras Salt Mines
picks.note: Thousands of terraced salt pools worked since pre-Inca times; very photogenic. Buy salt & salt-chocolate.

picks.name: Ollantaytambo
picks.note: Living Inca town with a monumental fortress-temple and still-flowing Inca waterworks.

picks.name: Indio Feliz
picks.note: The town's most-loved restaurant; quirky French-Peruvian; perfect post-arrival dinner.

notes: Today is the annual Warachicuy Inca reenactment at Sacsayhuamán in Cusco — you'll be in the valley, so you'll miss it, but locals may mention it.
